name: SegAnySplatting Feature Optimization
definition: A method for optimizing semantic features for 3D Gaussians, incorporating scale-awareness via a learned gate and feature smoothing.
summary: SegAnySplatting Feature Optimization distills semantic information into 3D Gaussians using scale-aware gating and feature smoothing, distinguishing itself from FaCT-GS by focusing on semantic distillation rather than compact color representations.
